Text.text: You are an operations assistant completing a task with the available tools. Work autonomously and never ask the user questions. Be efficient: keep the number of steps as low as you can. When the task is complete, call the `submit_result` tool exactly once with the JSON shape requested in the task, then stop.

Clean up our CRM contacts: (1) rewrite every phone number that is not already in E.164 format (US numbers: `+1` followed by exactly 10 digits, no spaces or punctuation) into E.164, leaving already-valid numbers untouched; (2) for every contact whose company field is empty, fill it with the company name matching the contact's email domain (see list_companies). Do not change any other field or any already-correct value. When done, submit {"phones_fixed": <count>, "companies_filled": <count>} via submit_result.

Text.text: I'll scan all contacts and companies, then fix phones and fill companies in one pass.

local companies = tool('list_companies', {})
local domain_to_company = {}
for _, c in ipairs(companies) do
  if c.domain then domain_to_company[c.domain] = c.name end
end

local function is_e164(phone)
  if not phone then return false end
  return string.match(phone, '^%+1%d%d%d%d%d%d%d%d%d%d$') ~= nil
end

local function to_e164(phone)
  if not phone or phone == '' then return nil end
  local digits = string.gsub(phone, '%D', '')
  if #digits == 10 then
    return '+1' .. digits
  elseif #digits == 11 and string.sub(digits, 1, 1) == '1' then
    return '+' .. digits
  elseif #digits > 0 then
    -- try last 10 digits if longer
    if #digits > 10 then
      local last10 = string.sub(digits, -10)
      return '+1' .. last10
    end
  end
  return nil
end

local phones_fixed = 0
local companies_filled = 0
local page = 1
local total_pages = 1
local updates = {}

repeat
  local r = tool('list_contacts', { page = page })
  total_pages = r.total_pages
  for _, contact in ipairs(r.items) do
    local new_phone = nil
    local new_company = nil
    
    if contact.phone and contact.phone ~= '' and not is_e164(contact.phone) then
      local fixed = to_e164(contact.phone)
      if fixed and fixed ~= contact.phone then
        new_phone = fixed
      end
    end
    
    local company_empty = (not contact.company or contact.company == '')
    if company_empty and contact.email then
      local domain = string.match(contact.email, '@(.+)$')
      if domain and domain_to_company[domain] then
        new_company = domain_to_company[domain]
      end
    end
    
    if new_phone or new_company then
      local args = { id = contact.id }
      if new_phone then args.phone = new_phone end
      if new_company then args.company = new_company end
      tool('update_contact', args)
      if new_phone then phones_fixed = phones_fixed + 1 end
      if new_company then companies_filled = companies_filled + 1 end
      updates[#updates + 1] = { id = contact.id, phone = new_phone, company = new_company, old_phone = contact.phone, email = contact.email }
    end
  end
  page = page + 1
until page > total_pages

return { phones_fixed = phones_fixed, companies_filled = companies_filled, updates = updates, domains = domain_to_company }
